title: Quiz — Chapter 2.1: Writing and Graphing Inequalities

hints: Think of the phrase 'no less than'.
It allows the boundary value itself.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: x < 5 means x is less than 5.
hints: The symbol < points to the smaller side.
questions.prompt: The inequality $ x < 5 $ is read as 'x is ___ than 5'.
Translate into an inequality: 'A number y is at most 10'.
hints: 'At most' means the value cannot go above 10.
Use the symbol that includes equality.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: 8 + 2 = 10, which is not greater than 10, so no.
A closed (filled) circle is used for ≤ or ≥.
questions.prompt: When graphing an inequality on a number line, use a ___ circle for ≤ or ≥.
hints: It indicates that the boundary point is included.
The opposite of an open circle.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Open circle at -4 with right shading gives x > -4.
questions.prompt: A graph has an open circle at -4 and shading to the right. Write the inequality using x.
Which key phrase matches the symbol '≤'?
hints: It means you cannot exceed a certain value.

questions.prompt: The collection of all values that satisfy an inequality is called the solution ___.
hints: It's the full range of answers.
Is the result greater than or equal to 10?
questions.prompt: Is -6 a solution of $ 10 \le 3 - m $? Answer yes or no.

hints: ≥ includes the number 1, so the circle is closed.
Greater than means shading to the right.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: x ≥ 1: closed circle at 1, shade right.

questions.prompt: The symbol '>' is often used with phrases like 'more than' or '___'.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: > can be read as 'greater than', 'more than', or 'exceeds'.

questions.prompt: Translate: 'Twice a number x minus 4 is at least 6'.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: Closed circle at 0, left shading → x ≤ 0.
questions.prompt: A graph has a closed circle at 0 and shading to the left. Which inequality is it?
hints: Closed circle means equality is included.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: You substitute the number for the variable to test the inequality.
questions.prompt: To check if a number is a solution of an inequality, you ___ the variable with that number and simplify.

hints: Divide 21 by each candidate and check the inequality.
questions.prompt: Which number is a solution of $ 21 \div x \ge -3.5 $?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: 21 ÷ (-7) = -3, which is ≥ -3.5, so -7 is a solution.
